summary: Confirmed on the operator's 2026 price list: $50 (30-amp FHU) to $70 (50-amp holiday), 50-amp full hookups. Added back-in sites, holiday 3-night minimum, Campspot booking link, marina general store. Not stated: site count, max rig length, season, showers.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night (30-amp full hookup, 2026) sits exactly at the US$50 line, not over it.

Possible long-stay mix: the operator advertises 'short term, long term and seasonal plans' and monthly sites ('Working in the area? We have you covered with a variety of monthly sites'); nightly vacation sites are sold alongside, so probably fine under the five-test rule, but a human may want to look.
